text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA,July 29 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels, containers 2-3 days, bulk 10-12 days, general cargo 3-4 days. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging. 2 Discharging at anchorage, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 6 to discharge, 1 under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Floating crane Shravan laid up from 5/8 for indefinite period. Floating crane Shreshta will be laid up for annual inspection from mid-July for indefinite period. Calcutta - 21 Vessels due of which 1 coking coal, 5 product tankers, 8 containers, 1 crude, 2 tneb coal, 2 logs, 1 general cargo, 1 steel and wheels. 8 Vessels loading at berth, 17 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 11 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 bunkering.

Cochin - 11 Vessels due, up to 1 days delay expected. 1 Loading at berth, 4 discharging, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 general car vessel, 1 pax vessel at repair dock, 1 tanker at csl jetty, 1 tug undergoing repairs at berth. Madras - 39 Vessels due of which 8 coal, 3 general, 2 fertiliser, 5 iron ore, 1 barytes, 8 containers, 3 palm oil, 2 sunflower oil, 2 quartz, 1 manganese ore, 1 lube oil, 2 coke, 1 passenger. Delays expected coal/coke 2-3 days, fertiliser, scrap 5-6 days, others 2-3 days, iron ore 2-3 days. no delays for containers. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging, 9 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Mormugao - One vessel due, up to 1 days delay expected. 1 Loading at berth, 3 discharging. Repair/drydock - 1 At drydock, 1 at berth 5, 1 at anchorage, 1 awaiting orders. Labour situation normal.

Kandla - 15 Vessels due, 15-16 days berthing delay. 4 Loading at berth, 2 loading in stream, 4 discharging at berth, 3 discharging in stream, 9 waiting to load, 9 to discharge, 3 tankers. 22 Vessels waiting. Mangalore - 12 Vessels due, 2-3 days delay. 8 Loading/discharging at berth. Jawaharlal Nehru - Berthing delays, urea 20-25 days, other fertiliser 25-30 days, tankers/iron ore 1-2 days. 4 Tankers/iron ore vessels due, 2 fertiliser/raw material discharging at berth, 1 iron ore discharging at anchorage, 1 tanker/iron ore, 2 fertiliser/raw material waiting at anchorage to discharge. Bulk berth no.4 not available until 30/9.

Paradip - 10 due, 3-4 days berthing delay expected. 3 Loading at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge. Tuticorin - 10 Vessels due, 1-2 days berthing delay. 3 Loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge, 1 under repair/drydock. Visakhapatnam - 18 Due, 7-8 days berthing delay expected. 7 Loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 10 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 6 waiting to load at inner harbour berth.

MALAYSIA, July 30 - Port Keelang - North/south port container/ro-ro berth - 7 Vessels alongside, 8 waiting, 3 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 3 Vessels alongside, 2 berthed, 1 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Dry/bulk cement terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 3 waiting, 4 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Alongside, 6 waiting, 2 days waiting time. West port container/ro-ro berth - 2 Alongside, 1 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Deep aft conventional wharf - 5 Alongside, 2 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Dry/bulk cement terminal - 2 Alongside, 1 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 1 Alongside, no waiting time.

MAURITIUS, July 29 - Port Louis - All berths occupied. 5 Vessels alongside discharging of which 3 containers, 2 general cargo. No idle vessels, 1 in drydock. Fishing port - 19 Alongside for bunkering/discharging/loading fish. 1-2 Days delay 30/7 to 1/8 due to bunching of vessels.

PAKISTAN, July 28 - Karachi - Two vessels due. Up to 1 days delay for general cargo/containers, up to 2 days for tankers. 3 Vessels loading rice at berth, 6 containers loading and discharging at berth. 6 Discharging at berth (general cargo, sugar, crude oil, gas oil, gas. 1 Waiting at anchorage to load rice, 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge sugar, sulphur, crude oil, hsd. 3 Awaiting orders. No work performed on 24/7 due to referendum of Karachi dock labour union. Port Qasim - Six vessels loading at berth (palm oil, wheat, iron ore, sugar, fuel oil). 4 Waiting at anchorage to discharge lpg, wheat and fuel oil.

PHILIPPINES, July 28 - Manila - South harbour - 11 Vessels discharging at berth, 14 discharging at inner anchorage berth, 10 waiting at outside anchorage to discharge. Average waiting time for vessels with a draft more or less than 8 metres and loa less than 130 metres 2-5 days. Draft more than 9 metres and loa more than 140 metres 5-7 days.

TAIWAN, July 28 - Keelung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain, steel, iron ore 3 days, coal 4 days. Kaohsiung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 3 days, iron/coal (CSC berth), coal/scrap (public berth) 4 days, steel 2 days. Taichung - Seven vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 13-14 days, iron ore, coal, scrap, steel 1 day, others 1-2 days. July 29 - Keelung - Up to 1 day delay for vessels due. 9 Vessels loading at berth, 25 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Kaohsiung - One day delay for vessels due. 10 Vessels loading at berth, 52 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 5 bunkering.
